  CITY COUNCIL

Tuesday, February 13, 2024  5:00 PM  City Hall

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mayor has called a Special Meeting of the City Council, to be called to
order in the City Hall Conference room at 5:00 p.m. on Tuesday, February 13, 2024. The agenda for the Special
Meeting with the items of business to be transacted or discussed is set forth below.
Posted by the office of the City Clerk on Thursday, February 8, 2024.

NOTE:  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION INFORMATION
  Agenda reports and other disclosable public records relating to each Open Session agenda item are
  available on the City's web site under City Council Meeting agendas at www.RollingHillsEstatesCA.gov
  and during regular business hours in the office of the City Clerk. Meetings are live broadcast on the City's
  web site and a recording is available for viewing after each meeting. Meetings are also broadcast on
  PVP-TV Channel 35 (Cox) and Channel 39 (Verizon).

  Public Comment is welcome on any item during City Council consideration of the item. An opportunity is
  also provided for the public to comment on non-agenda items concerning City matters. If you would like to
  address the City Council regarding an item on this agenda or make a general public comment, please
  complete a speaker sheet and give to the City Clerk.

MINUTES
  SPECIAL CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  FEBRUARY 13, 2024

1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

A Special meeting of the City Council of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called to order
by MAYOR SCHMITZ at 5:00 PM.

3.  ROLL CALL

City Council Members Present:  Brown Schachter, Huff, Schmitz, Stegura, Zerunyan
City Council Members Absent:  None

4.  NEW BUSINESS

A.  INTERVIEWS OF APPLICANTS FOR ENVIRONMENTAL ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  AND TRAFFIC & SAFETY COMMITTEE VACANCIES

The City Council conducted interviews of the following applicants to serve on the
Environmental Advisory Committee and the Traffic & Safety Committee:

  5:00 pm – Micah Rapoport
  5:10 pm – Annalia Henderson
  5:20 pm – Claire Williams
  5:30 pm – Gregory Henderson
  5:40 pm – Andrew Rein
  5:50 pm – Ryan Halvorsen
  6:00 pm – BREAK
  6:10 pm – David Rowe
  6:20 pm – Evan Garcia
  6:30 pm – Marie Reichert
  6:40 pm – Mike Cassidy

5.  ADJOURNMENT

MAYOR SCHMITZ adjourned the Special City Council meeting to the regular City Council
meeting.

Submitted by,  Approved by,

Lauren Pettit  Velveth Schmitz
City Clerk  Mayor
